name: Plane Composing Algorithms
definition: Direct volume rendering algorithms that operate by compositing several slices which comprise a volumetric model. They tend to work best when the view-plane is fixed parallel to the model.
summary: Plane Composing Algorithms are direct volume rendering methods that composite slices to leverage spatial coherence, differing from ray casting by exploiting texture-based rendering and shear-warp factorization for efficiency.
